chain.title: Beyond the Beehive
chain.desc: Enter using the mod's beehive teleport interaction. Keep a return plan and inspect the Bumblezone advancements.

chain.title: Explore Without Starting a War
chain.desc: Gather pollen while observing the bees. Taking protected honey or attacking bees can trigger Wrath of the Hive.

chain.title: Make Friends with the Hive
chain.desc: Prepare Bee Bread and feed bees. Helping the hive offers a friendlier route through the dimension.

chain.title: Crystals in the Honey Valleys
chain.desc: Explore for Honey Crystal Shards. They supply a separate equipment branch.

chain.title: Refine the Crystal Supply
chain.desc: Craft Honey Crystals using your recipe viewer before selecting an equipment upgrade.

chain.title: A Shield for the Expedition
chain.desc: Craft the Honey Crystal Shield and test it before exploring deeper structures.

chain.title: A Carefully Gathered Stinger
chain.desc: Obtain a Bee Stinger through an available drop or recipe route. Avoid provoking the whole hive unnecessarily.

chain.title: A Spear for Close Encounters
chain.desc: Craft a Stinger Spear for the combat side of your expedition.

chain.title: Find Your Way Through the Hive
chain.desc: Inspect the Honey Compass tooltip. A special throne-locating compass points toward the Bee Queen; ordinary variants differ.

chain.title: Meet the Queen's Requests
chain.desc: Trade with the Bee Queen to begin her requests. Completing them earns Royal Jelly Bottles.

chain.title: Recognition from the Hive
chain.desc: Complete the Queen's Desire advancement line for this essence. Consume it to earn lasting acceptance and access to the Sanctum events.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Dimension entry, bee-friendly gathering, equipment and Bee Queen exploration.
coverage.limitations: Official documentation reviewed; no matching local JAR was available for this audit. Compass variants and Queen requirements are version-dependent. Runtime scanning must filter unsupported entries.
coverage.verification_detail: Every guide item and mod-specific check icon has a model in the official version source tree. Mechanics use official documentation; no local installation or playthrough was verified.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
verified_against: Official 1.20-Arch source assets (2eff22187bfe); no installed JAR verified
